quotations: Alibaba’s Qwen team has released Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo , an accelerated checkpoint of its open-weight Qwen-Image-2.1 model. It generates and edits images in 8 denoising steps instead of the base model’s 40-step default . For developers, that means 5x fewer denoising steps on the same 7B architecture, plus a hosted API option. TL;DR Size: 7
